reports.headline: Something Huge Croaking by the Cliffs
reports.body: A croaking loud enough to shake the shutters has come from the cliffs {dir} of the village {dist} three nights running. {name} went to look and found a hollow in the grass the size of a cart, as if something had come down on it from a height.

reports.headline: Animals Crushed Flat Near the Cliffs
reports.body: {name} found two of {their} {animal} flattened in the grass below the cliffs {dir} of here {dist}, as though something enormous had landed on them. There was a smell like a stagnant pond, and handprints, human handprints, far too wide.

reports.headline: The Pond Below the Cliffs Has Gone Foul
reports.body: The pond under the cliffs {dir} of the village {dist} has turned thick and green overnight. {name} says the water bulged as {they} watched, like something breathing under it, and that it had eyes on top, orange ones.
